violations.text: Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of (sugar and salt). Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Containers were removed during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the two door prep unit. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. The handle on the walk in cooler was not in good repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the fan covers in the walk in cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2026

The outside dumpster is not covered (dumpster cover is broken). Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. Establishment has placed service call, to have dumpster lids replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026

Knifes were observed stored on an unclean surface (between prep table and wall) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Knifes were moved to three bay sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/06/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the of the blower fan guard in the walk in cooler has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
